status.scope_reason: The company manufactures drones and operates a Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) business model providing agricultural spraying, land mapping, and infrastructure monitoring services.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records published on The Company Check and Tracxn, Vyomik Innovations Private Limited is an active company incorporated in 2020, headquartered in Hyderabad, and engaged in drone manufacturing and drone-based operational services.

claims.claim: The company reports it has manufactured 100+ drones and operates its own fleet of drones and pilots to provide drone services across India.

The company reports it has developed two Kisan drones for agricultural spraying (including the DGCA certified, 10-liter multirotor models SID-VD610 and SID-A610) and two drones optimized for land survey and mapping.

Vyomik Innovations Private Limited has designed and assembled the SID-A610 (medium class) and the SID VD610, which are Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) type-certified agriculture spraying drones.
The company reported in mid-2026 that it is developing an indigenous agriculture spray drone with 80% of its components being "Made in India," alongside a new 50 kg payload capacity drone.

The company reports delivering diverse mapping and surveying offerings such as photogrammetry, LiDAR, RGB, thermal, and multispectral sensors to provide 2D orthomosaics, 3D models, DEMs, and point clouds.

The company reports that it plans to develop a robust technology platform under its Drone as a Service (DaaS) model to collect data and generate data intelligence, offering value-added benefits and services to farmers and end-customers.

The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) in India officially issued a type certificate in June 2024 to Vyomik Innovations Private Limited for its medium-class unmanned aircraft system (UAS) model "SID-A610" designed for agricultural operations.
The company reports the development and sale of the "SID-VD610," which is a DGCA-certified 10-liter payload agricultural spraying drone.

Vyomik Innovations Pvt. Ltd. was awarded an aggregate contract value of ₹1.59 crore by Telangana State Technology Services (TGTS) in November 2025 for the pilot implementation of drone-based spot spraying in agriculture.

The company signed a memorandum of understanding with the ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR) in June 2022 to conduct research on drone evaluation and standard operating protocols for rice seeding and spraying.

The company filed financial statements for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2025, reporting a total revenue of ₹9.19 crore, a 98% growth compared to the previous year, and a profit after tax of ₹77.9 lakh.
The company pitched at the Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE), IIIT Hyderabad Startup Demo Day on January 20, 2022, securing incubation support and early stage seed funding.
claims.source: CIE IIIT Hyderabad Press Release (The Print); Tracxn

claims.claim: The company reports offering its drone survey, mining survey, and construction monitoring services with a site location availability designated as "Pan India".
The company has actively recruited for state-level leadership, such as a "State Head – Sales" role covering Andhra Pradesh to expand its distributor and institutional dealer networks.

Vyomik Innovations Pvt. Ltd. signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) on 27 June 2022 with the ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR) to collaborate on evaluating drone applications, testing drone-based direct rice seeding, standardizing pesticide/fertilizer spraying protocols, and mapping crop stress.
claims.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Rice Research (ICAR-IIRR) Official MoU Announcement

claims.claim: The company reports in its corporate investment documentation that it has entered into strategic collaborations with multiple crop protection companies and farmer organizations to scale its Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) business model, alongside establishing a channel network to build out state-level drone dealerships and distributor frameworks.
claims.source: Vyomik Innovations: Drone Solutions Overview (Investment Memorandum)

claims.claim: The company reports a total team size of over 55 employees, which includes a dedicated pilot team of more than 37 pilots.
claims.source: Vyomik Innovations: Drone Solutions Overview (Investment Memorandum)

claims.claim: The company reports that it has deployed a total of 20 drone units and has plans to establish three Remote Pilot Training Organisations (RPTOs) across India to support its critical manpower expansion.
claims.source: Vyomik Innovations: Drone Solutions Overview (Investment Memorandum)

status.main_product: Commercial drone services including aerial survey, mapping, inspection, and data analytics
status.scope_reason: The company explicitly provides end-to-end commercial drone services such as drone surveying, mapping, industrial inspections, and data analytics under its own brand.
status.evidence: According to the Ministry of Corporate Affairs registry records compiled by Tracxn, Aerizone Creative Labs Private Limited is registered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with an 'Active' corporate status as of July 2026.

claims.claim: The company reports owning and operating a comprehensive fleet of multi-rotor and fixed-wing Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems (RPAS), integrating payloads such as RTK, PPK, LiDAR, thermal, and multispectral imaging for enterprise data acquisition.

The company reports offering customized enterprise drone services encompassing aerial mapping, topographic drone surveys, 2D/3D GIS mapping, asset inspections, and aerial filming across sectors like railways, mining, construction, utilities, and telecom.

The company reports providing integrated drone-based software platforms and professional UAV data processing services to convert raw aerial data into geospatial intelligence such as orthomosaics, DEMs, and GIS-ready datasets compatible with standard platforms.

HydroIndia Engineering Services confirmed it has partnered with Aerizone Creative Labs Pvt. Ltd. over a multi-year period, utilizing the company's drone solutions to execute level surveys and high-resolution orthoimage workflows across multiple municipal dumping yards.

The company has established dedicated client placement or project profiles indicating service provision or active engagement with high-profile entities such as Toyota, PowerGrid, and the Water Resources Department (WRD) of Maharashtra.
The company's operating revenue range was reported as under INR 1 crore for the financial year ending on March 31, 2022, with its EBITDA decreasing by 8.64% over the previous year.

The company reports executing drone mapping, survey, and level assessment projects within Maharashtra, including Full Reservoir Level mapping of the Narmada River and aerial surveys of 26 railway level crossings.
Aerizone Creative Labs Pvt. Ltd. lists individual roles such as certified UAV pilots, GIS analysts, survey teams, and project managers in its hiring and project workflows.
claims.note: certified UAV pilots, survey teams, project managers
claims.source: Aerizone Careers Page (https://aerizone.com) and Official Website (https://aerizone.com/)
